履修条件
Students should have interest in various studies on building structure, in addition have wide knowledge and technique for discussion.
授業概要
Recent studies on building structure, especially steel structures and CFT structures, will be reviewed, and future problems will be lectured. Some solutions for these problems will be discussed by participants. New problems will be found through the discussion.
授業形態
（項目）
■ lecture・exercise
■ experiment
■ presentation
■ discussion
授業形態
（内容）
使用する教材等
Blackboard, Textbooks, PPT, etc.
全体の教育目標
Students will experience the process leading to the proposal of solutions from the extraction of problems, and learn necessary knowledge and technique.
個別の教育目標
Since contents to be learned depend on the individual theme setting, students will basically acquire the knowledge on their own and build a research technique of their own through the discussions with the teacher.
授業計画
・To review the recent studies on building structures;
・to extract problems and set the individual theme;
・to examine the way of procedures;
・to discuss with the teacher repeatedly;
・to summarize the conclusions for the report;
・to held presentation and discuss with other participants.
キーワード
Building structure, Structural testing, Numerical analysis, Seismic, Connection, Frame, Sustainability
授業の進め方
The research and investigation will be proceeded along the lesson plan. Discussions with the teacher will be repeated depending on the individual progress.
If necessary, the teacher will introduce the relevant literatures and provide the necessary knowledge.
